method: fresh on-policy finite V-MPO-style nonparametric E-step / parametric M-step policy iteration
structural_difference: E-step stable top-half normalized advantages -> exponential sample weights with explicit KL-to-uniform dual solve; M-step weighted Gaussian log-likelihood fitting plus detached adaptive mean-KL multiplier. No PPO likelihood ratio/clipping, score-companion policy gradient, Fisher/CG/TRPO line search, Q/TD/replay/target actor, entropy regularization/SAC alpha, action-codebook/C51 or whole-policy perturbation/CEM. Not imitation of an old teacher or static interpolation/MSE. Fresh model, optimizer and RNG; old arrays only offline interface parity, never learning.
variant_limits: Finite fixed-sigma separate actor/value, complete MC instead of n-step bootstrap, normalized advantages, deterministic bounded E-dual solve, 64 full-batch M-step attempts with whole-final-proposal reject when mean-KL bound or weighted-likelihood improvement fails. Not literal reproduction of original V-MPO, no convergence/monotonic improvement/physical-safety claim.

policy.inputs: tanh(current actual native50), tanh(causal initial native50), min(control/528,1)
policy.action: controls1..528 reference+.18*tanh(latent), replaces ten old leg corrections; control0/head/home529+ unchanged

learning.returns: Complete original MC including home tail and original invalid terminal, no cross-reset bootstrap
learning.advantage: return minus pre-update value; active-only normalized once before actor/value updates

m_step.accept: final finite mean KL<=.001 and weighted negative log-likelihood strictly below old; otherwise restore actor/actor Adam/alpha

storage.include: all numeric/preflight/launcher/smoke/formal outputs, external tmp/logs, new sources/receipts, future archive and Git increment; enforce actual plus forecast
